name: qa-resume-20261005-app-host-c8b417-host-inspector
command:
set +e
unit='qa-resume-20261005-app-host-c8b417-managed.service'
dir='/tmp/qa-repair-20260930-101945-app-web/c8b417'
bin="$dir/binary"
printf 'hostname=%s
' "$(hostname)"
printf 'unit=%s
' "$unit"
systemctl show "$unit" --no-pager -p LoadState -p ActiveState -p SubState -p MainPID -p Result -p FragmentPath
pid="$(systemctl show "$unit" -p MainPID --value 2>/dev/null)"
printf 'unit_main_pid=%s
' "$pid"
if [ -n "$pid" ] && [ "$pid" != 0 ] && [ -e "/proc/$pid/exe" ]; then printf 'unit_main_exe=%s
' "$(readlink "/proc/$pid/exe")"; printf 'unit_main_sha256=%s
' "$(sha256sum "/proc/$pid/exe" | cut -d' ' -f1)"; else printf 'unit_main_exe=none
unit_main_sha256=none
'; fi
if [ -e "$bin" ]; then printf 'binary_exists=yes
'; printf 'binary_sha256=%s
' "$(sha256sum "$bin" | cut -d' ' -f1)"; printf 'binary_size=%s
' "$(stat -c %s "$bin")"; else printf 'binary_exists=no
'; fi
if [ -e "$dir/config.ini" ]; then printf 'config_exists=yes
config_content='; cat "$dir/config.ini"; printf '
'; else printf 'config_exists=no
'; fi
unitfile="/etc/systemd/system/$unit"
if [ -e "$unitfile" ]; then printf 'unit_file_exists=yes
'; sed -n '1,40p' "$unitfile"; else printf 'unit_file_exists=no
'; fi
